sources.title: Age Estimation and Gender Classification from Facial Images
sources.snippet: For a computational model, gender recognition is a binary classification problem and thus inherently simpler than age estimation, which often involves regression. The potential applications of age and gender recognition systems are wide, ranging from entertainment and marketing to forensic identification and access control in security systems.

sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers.
